title: Giving the Reason: ya que, puesto que, dado que, como
goal: Give a reason that is already known with ya que, puesto que, dado que and como, and tell them from porque.
grammar: ya que, puesto que, dado que, como

items: I can give a known reason with *ya que*, *puesto que* and *dado que*.
I can start a sentence with *como* and a reason.
I can tell *porque* from the other reason markers.
